messages:
maya: Quick idea: tighten postmortem follow-ups with a small remediation workflow. Goals: single owner SLA, 30/60/90 checkpoints, weekly digest to #incidents, and a "remediation shepherd" per sprint. Thoughts?

nate: yes. ownership drift is the main leak. Suggest a mandatory template on creation: owner, due_epoch, severity, recurrence_tag, blocked_by(optional). If unassigned in 48h auto-assign to oncall lead.

olga: add last_update_epoch and closure_reason (fix/deferred/dup). We should also tag type=remediation so it doesn't mix with product tasks.

maya: automation plan: reminders 7d/1d before due -> ping owner, cc manager; weekly digest Mon 09:00 with 3 bullets: top overdue, new recurring patterns, closed this week.

ops-bot: Automation registered (reminders + weekly_digest) pending opt-in: remflow-2026-07.

nate: rotation: IC weekly, shepherd = 2-week role that nudges and escalates. New IC shadows outgoing IC for 48-72h for context.

olga: metrics to track during pilot: open_count, avg_time_to_close, percent_closed_by_due, recurrence_score (count_in_90d). Also add alert: open>21d && recurrence_score>1.

maya: pilot plan: run 6 weeks on auth+kv services. Next steps: maya create lane+template by Fri, nate implement recurrence tags+alert by Wed, olga add epoch fields+backfill by Thu. Reconvene weekly here.

ops-bot: Created pilot tasks: https://redwood/tasks/4001, https://redwood/tasks/4002, https://redwood/tasks/4003

maya: thanks — aiming to cut repeated incidents and shrink remediation slippage.
